queries.query: 下週的簡報幫我從頭做一遍，先把溝通定位講清楚，再往下排架構。
queries.note: This skill is user-invoked (disable-model-invocation / allow_implicit_invocation: false), so it has no live trigger surface and this file is a record of what the description was tuned against, not evidence that anything fires. Kept because the description still has to read as this work to a human choosing a skill by name.

queries.query: 投影片太多講不完，老闆說看不到重點，幫我想這場要怎麼收。
queries.note: The user names a symptom rather than a node; the description has to cover the case where the skill picks the node and says why.

queries.query: 幫我把這幾頁的標題改成結論式標題，內容不用動。
queries.note: Single-node entry with no prior artifacts — the commonest real request, and the one the description must not make sound like a mandatory full workflow.

queries.query: Can you review my deck page by page and tell me what a room would actually miss? I present on Thursday.
queries.note: English entry into the layout-review node. Output language follows the request, so an English ask is in scope.

queries.query: 幫我用 python-pptx 把這份大綱產成 .pptx 檔，套公司的範本。
queries.note: Building the deck file itself. This skill advises the presenter and writes Markdown artifacts; it never produces the .pptx. Routes to a pptx workflow.

queries.query: 幫我把這個專案成果做成一張資訊圖表，一頁看完那種懶人包。
queries.note: Designing a standalone explanatory graphic. Routes to infographic-design. Note the near-miss: this skill's 一頁收攏 node also produces a one-page thing, but that is an argument compressed into text, not a designed visual.

queries.query: 這段簡報講稿的 AI 味幫我拿掉，「賦能」「全面提升」那種空話改掉，結構不要動。
queries.note: Pure language cleanup on finished prose, explicitly no structural work. Routes to humanizer-zh.

queries.query: 幫我擬一份系統汰換的簽呈，要有背景、方案比較、經費、風險跟建議事項。
queries.note: Authoring one formal written document to a fixed institutional shape, for a reader who reads it alone. Routes to formal-doc-structure. Same underlying material as a deck often is, but nobody stands up and delivers a 簽呈.
